QUOTE: `library/common.h:132` defines `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` unconditionally... `library/common.h` is internal and not installed, and 107 library `.c` files include it. Inside those files, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` resolves to the real `x`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that library-internal code enables the opt-out in the shared header `library/common.h`, so library translation units see plain member names.
